summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, address accumulated PR review comments, resolve deployment pipeline issues (Grafana provisioning, desktop signing), update outdated codebase docs, and fix a newly failing writable-shares E2E test.
summary.outcome: All CI failures were fixed and merged: vault recovery test (protobuf field bug + resolution order), desktop build signing key wiring, Grafana API key rotation guidance, and writable-shares text editor save failure. Codebase docs were fully rewritten for multi-package architecture. PR #376 for the writable-shares fix was open with review comments being addressed at session end.

repo: IPNS record protobuf field layout: value is field 1 (not field 2 as previously coded); field 2 is signatureV1. extractCidFromIpnsRecord in recovery.html had this wrong.
resolveIpns() in recovery.html previously tried the IPFS gateway HEAD first (15s timeout that hangs in CI when Kubo can't resolve mock-ipns-routing names); delegated routing should be first.

Standalone file shares create a synthetic FilePointer with id=shareId, but the file-ipns key in share_keys is stored with itemId=fileId (real file UUID), causing IPNS key lookup to fail in getFileIpnsKeyFn.

TextEditorDialog Ctrl+S handler has a stale closure issue: fill() is async/React-rendered, but the isDirty flag in the save closure won't be true until React re-renders. Must wait for modified indicator before pressing Ctrl+S.
TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD were in repo secrets but not wired into the tauri-action steps across all 3 platform build jobs in deploy-staging.yml.
Grafana Cloud returns HTTP 404 (not 401/403) for API requests with an invalid/expired service account token, making it look like a URL misconfiguration rather than auth failure.
The NODE_ENV=test API mode disables rate throttling; running web-e2e with NODE_ENV=development causes 429s during account creation steps, making the full suite unreliable locally.
Running two Playwright suites in parallel against the same API/DB/mock-ipns-routing causes interference and flaky failures in shared state tests.

code.finding: Vault key blob fetch tried IPFS gateway /ipns/ path first with 30s timeout before delegated routing fallback — should use resolveIpns() (delegated routing first) instead.
extractCidFromIpnsRecord checked fieldNumber === 2 (signatureV1) when it should check fieldNumber === 1 (value) per IPNS protobuf spec.
fetchWithRetry only triggered backoff on thrown errors, not on non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx). Added !resp.ok check.
resp.json() consumed the response body; falling through to resp.arrayBuffer() on the same response would fail. Fixed with else branch.

Standalone file shares build synthetic FilePointer with id=shareId, but file-ipns key is stored with itemId=fileId. Added fallback in getFileIpnsKeyFn to use first file-ipns key when exact itemId match fails, scoped only to standalone shares (permission !== 'folder').
Test 10.3 must wait for modified status indicator after textarea.fill() before pressing Ctrl+S, otherwise isDirty is still false in the save handler's closure.
TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD were missing from all three tauri-action steps (macOS, Windows, Linux).

workflow: Run web-e2e locally with NODE_ENV=test on the API to avoid 429s masking real test failures.
Never run multiple Playwright suites in parallel against a shared test API — state interference causes cascading failures.
When fetching CI failure logs via gh CLI, the job must be complete before logs are available.
Grafana Cloud service account tokens (for dashboard provisioning via HTTP API) are separate from Loki/Prometheus data source API keys.
When re-running CI for transient SSH timeout failures, verify the VPS is reachable from your local machine before assuming it's a code issue.
Git worktrees from previous sessions can become stale after branches merge; prune them with git worktree prune + git worktree remove --force.

friction: Multiple CI round-trips before being asked to run E2E tests locally first — the writable-shares failure required 3 CI runs before local reproduction was used.
The 'wait for modified indicator' fix (stale closure) didn't actually fix the CI failure — the real bug was the IPNS key ID mismatch, not a timing issue. This added an unnecessary CI cycle.
The full web-e2e suite locally showed different failures (8.2) than CI (10.3) due to throttling differences, making it hard to correlate.
Markdownlint pre-commit hook blocked the codebase docs commit due to MD036 emphasis-as-heading and bare code fences — docs written by agents didn't conform to project lint rules.
Background task notifications for services that were already killed appeared mid-session and required context-clearing.
Two parallel Playwright suite runs (background full suite + targeted writable-shares run) conflicted and caused flaky failures requiring manual process cleanup.
open_items: PR #376 (writable-shares file-ipns key fallback fix) was open with unresolved review comments at session end — CodeRabbit flagged the fallback being too broad for folder shares; fix was being scoped to standalone shares only.
docs/milestone-v1.1-completion branch has codebase doc updates but hasn't been PR'd or merged yet.
6 pending todos in .planning/ were noted but not reviewed (deferred to /gsd:check-todos).
GSD milestone completion (/gsd:complete-milestone) was identified as the next action but not executed.
Full web-e2e suite with NODE_ENV=test API was kicked off as background task but results weren't confirmed before session end.
The .planning/config.json modification was noted as persistently dirty on main across multiple git switch operations — root cause not investigated.
